title: Supervisor health dashboard stale: 2d0h (#10)
body:
## Premise

The dashboard at #10 last refreshed `2026-05-07T23:08:42Z` — **2d0h ago** (threshold: 2d0h). The `stats-wrapper.sh` scheduler is likely failing silently.

## Why this matters

The supervisor health dashboard is the framework's primary single-glance health surface. When it stops refreshing, operators keep trusting green numbers that no longer reflect reality — every decision derived from "dashboard says green" becomes invalid.

## Triage

1. Inspect the stats scheduler status (macOS):

   ```bash
   launchctl list | grep -i aidevops-stats-wrapper
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist
   ```

2. Run the refresh manually and capture the error:

   ```bash
   bash ~/.aidevops/agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh 2>&1 | tail -40
   ```

3. Check the dashboard issue directly:

   ```bash
   gh api repos/wpallstars/wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices/issues/10 --jq '{updated_at, body_length: (.body|length)}'
   ```

## Remediation

- **Missing plist:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so `setup_stats_wrapper` reinstalls `com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist`.
- **`set -euo pipefail` fail:** the post-t2418 wrapper emits `HEALTH-DASHBOARD-FAIL exit=<N>` on error. Grep `stats.log` on that prefix.
- **Body size / API error:** inspect `stats.log` — look at `gh` HTTP errors and `_update_health_issue_for_repo` failures.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Root cause identified and documented on this issue.
- [ ] `gh issue view 10 --repo wpallstars/wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices` shows an update within 24h of closing this alert.
- [ ] `last_refresh:` marker is present in the dashboard body.

<!-- aidevops:generator=dashboard-freshness-check -->
<!-- aidevops:dashboard-freshness:wpallstars/wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices:10 -->

title: Supervisor health dashboard stale: 2d1h (#10)
body:
## Premise

The dashboard at #10 last refreshed `2026-05-17T06:00:57Z` — **2d1h ago** (threshold: 2d0h). The `stats-wrapper.sh` scheduler is likely failing silently.

## Why this matters

The supervisor health dashboard is the framework's primary single-glance health surface. When it stops refreshing, operators keep trusting green numbers that no longer reflect reality — every decision derived from "dashboard says green" becomes invalid.

## Triage

1. Inspect the stats scheduler status (macOS):

   ```bash
   launchctl list | grep -i aidevops-stats-wrapper
   tail -40 ~/.aidevops/logs/stats.log
   ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist
   ```

2. Run the refresh manually and capture the error:

   ```bash
   bash ~/.aidevops/agents/scripts/stats-wrapper.sh 2>&1 | tail -40
   ```

3. Check the dashboard issue directly:

   ```bash
   gh api repos/wpallstars/wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices/issues/10 --jq '{updated_at, body_length: (.body|length)}'
   ```

## Remediation

- **Missing plist:** re-run `setup.sh --non-interactive` (or `aidevops update`) with PULSE_ENABLED=true so `setup_stats_wrapper` reinstalls `com.aidevops.aidevops-stats-wrapper.plist`.
- **`set -euo pipefail` fail:** the post-t2418 wrapper emits `HEALTH-DASHBOARD-FAIL exit=<N>` on error. Grep `stats.log` on that prefix.
- **Body size / API error:** inspect `stats.log` — look at `gh` HTTP errors and `_update_health_issue_for_repo` failures.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Root cause identified and documented on this issue.
- [ ] `gh issue view 10 --repo wpallstars/wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices` shows an update within 24h of closing this alert.
- [ ] `last_refresh:` marker is present in the dashboard body.

title: Bring the plugin up to SEO Pro Stack standards (3.0.0): remove custom updater, WP 6.2 / PHP 7.4, Plugin Check clean
body:
<!-- aidevops:brief-schema=v2 -->

## Origin

- **Created:** 2026-10-03
- **Created by:** marcusquinn (ai-interactive)
- **Conversation context:** SEO Pro Stack now includes this plugin's behaviour ("Clean up deleted plugins"). The owner decided to keep this plugin maintained, because GitHub ranks well for searches about the "Plugin file does not exist" error. It brings people to SEO Pro Stack. This issue brings the code up to the same standards as SEO Pro Stack. The README rewrite that promotes SEO Pro Stack is a separate issue.

## What

A clean 3.0.0 of this plugin that:

- keeps its one job: list active plugins whose files are missing on the Plugins screen, add a "Remove notice" link, and clean up the missing plugin's entries;
- no longer touches WordPress update behaviour. Remove `includes/Updater.php`, the update-source selector (`admin/js/update-source-selector.js`, `admin/css/update-source-selector.css`, `admin/lib/Modal.php`) and every call that clears `update_plugins` or `plugins_api_*` transients in `includes/Core.php` (`prevent_plugins_api_caching`, `maybe_clear_plugin_api_cache`, `clear_all_plugin_transients`, `clear_own_plugin_cache`). GitHub updates come from the `GitHub Plugin URI` header (SEO Pro Stack's "Updates from GitHub" or Git Updater both read it);
- drops the `Update URI` header (line 20 of the main file) and keeps `GitHub Plugin URI`, adding `Primary Branch: main` and `Release Asset: true`;
- requires WordPress 6.2 and PHP 7.4 (headers and `readme.txt`);
- has capability and nonce checks on the remove action, escapes output, and uses short, plain admin copy in sentence case;
- removes `recently_activated` and `uninstall_plugins` entries for the missing plugin as well as the `active_plugins` entry;
- causes no PHP errors, warnings, notices or deprecations;
- builds `wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices-X.Y.Z.zip` with a `wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices/` folder, using `.distignore`;
- passes Plugin Check with no errors.

**Keep it small and lightweight (owner's direction).** This plugin solves one problem people sometimes have, and nothing else. Add no settings page, options, dashboard boxes, promotions, tracking or calls to outside services. Load nothing outside the Plugins screen (`plugins.php` and `plugins-network.php`). Prefer fewer files: if a class or JS/CSS file only exists for removed features, delete it. Aim for a release zip of a few tens of KB.

Also remove the AI tool clutter files from the repository root (`.augmentignore`, `.boltignore`, `.clinerc`, `.codyignore`, `.continuerc`, `.cursorignore`, `.geminiignore`, `.loveablerc`, `.rooignore`, `.v0ignore`, `.windsurfignore`, `.aiconfig`, `.ai-assistant.md`) and the unused CI configs (`.drone.yml`, `.woodpecker.yml`). Move anything still useful into `AGENTS.md`.

## Why

The plugin's custom updater and its update-transient clearing break WordPress.org guidelines (Plugin Check flags `plugin_updater_detected`). They also clear every plugin's update cache, which slows sites down. This plugin is now a search entry point for SEO Pro Stack, so it should show the same quality.

## Tier

**Selected tier:** `tier:standard`

**Tier rationale:** The removals are known, but the rewrite of `Core.php` and the build script needs implementation judgement.

## How (Approach)

### Files to Modify

- `EDIT: wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices.php` — headers (version 3.0.0, Requires at least 6.2, Requires PHP 7.4, drop Update URI, add Primary Branch and Release Asset); stop loading Updater
- `EDIT: includes/Plugin.php` — remove Updater and modal wiring
- `EDIT: includes/Core.php` — keep `get_invalid_plugins`, `add_missing_plugins_references`, `add_remove_reference_action`, `handle_remove_reference`, `remove_plugin_reference`, `admin_notices`; remove transient and plugins_api methods (lines 41-47 hooks, 313-619); extend removal to `recently_activated` and `uninstall_plugins`
- `EDIT: admin/lib/Admin.php`, `admin/js/admin-scripts.js`, `admin/css/admin-styles.css` — drop update-source UI
- `EDIT: build.sh`, `.distignore` — zip name and folder as above
- `EDIT: readme.txt`, `CHANGELOG.md` — 3.0.0 entry; keep readme.txt under 10 KB
- `EDIT: AGENTS.md`, `composer.json`

### Implementation Steps

1. Delete the updater, modal and selector files and their loaders.
2. Trim `Core.php` as above. Every admin action checks `current_user_can('activate_plugins')` and a nonce.
3. Update headers, `readme.txt` "Requires" lines and `build.sh`.
4. Add PHPCS (WordPress standard) and PHPStan through `composer.json` if they are missing, and fix what they find in the code.

### Hazards and Compatibility

- **Migration/rollback:** No stored options of its own except what `uninstall` touches; check `rg -n "get_option|update_option|set_transient"` and clean up any it created.
- **Mixed-version:** Sites on 2.x update through the `GitHub Plugin URI` header; the Updater removal must not stop that (Git Updater and SEO Pro Stack read the header, not this class).
- **Idempotency:** Removing an already removed entry is a no-op.

### Verification Before Dispatch

```bash
php -l on every PHP file; vendor/bin/phpcs; vendor/bin/phpstan
./build.sh  # check zip name and inner folder
# Throwaway WordPress 6.2 / PHP 7.4 site (wordpress:php7.4-apache): activate any plugin, delete its folder,
# open Plugins: the missing plugin is listed with "Remove notice"; click it; debug.log has no new messages
wp plugin install plugin-check --activate && wp plugin check wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices
```

### Files Scope

- `wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices.php`
- `includes/Plugin.php`
- `includes/Core.php`
- `includes/Updater.php`
- `admin/lib/Admin.php`
- `admin/lib/Modal.php`
- `admin/js/admin-scripts.js`
- `admin/js/update-source-selector.js`
- `admin/css/admin-styles.css`
- `admin/css/update-source-selector.css`
- `build.sh`
- `.distignore`
- `readme.txt`
- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `AGENTS.md`
- `composer.json`
- `.augmentignore`
- `.boltignore`
- `.clinerc`
- `.codyignore`
- `.continuerc`
- `.cursorignore`
- `.geminiignore`
- `.loveablerc`
- `.rooignore`
- `.v0ignore`
- `.windsurfignore`
- `.aiconfig`
- `.ai-assistant.md`
- `.drone.yml`
- `.woodpecker.yml`
- `languages/wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices.pot`

### Scope Boundaries

**Hard boundaries:** Do not add any code that changes WordPress update checks or transients. Do not publish a release; releasing needs the owner's say. `README.md` wording is the follow-up issue's job, so only touch it for factual changes (requirements, removed features).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] On the Plugins screen, a deleted active plugin is listed with a working "Remove notice" link, and clicking it removes the entry with no new debug.log messages.

  ```yaml
  verify:
    method: manual
    prompt: "On a throwaway WP 6.2 / PHP 7.4 site, delete an active plugin's folder, open Plugins, click Remove notice."
  ```

- [ ] No update-behaviour code remains.

  ```yaml
  verify:
    method: codebase
    pattern: "update_plugins|plugins_api|gul_update_server"
    path: "includes"
    expect: absent
  ```

- [ ] The main plugin file has no `Update URI` header.

  ```yaml
  verify:
    method: bash
    run: "! rg -q '^ \\* Update URI' wp-fix-plugin-does-not-exist-notices.php"
  ```

- [ ] Plugin Check reports no errors, and PHPCS and PHPStan are clean.
- [ ] The plugin header requires WordPress 6.2 and PHP 7.4, and `readme.txt` is under 10 KB.
- [ ] The plugin is still lightweight. It has no settings page or stored options of its own, enqueues nothing outside the Plugins screen, and makes no outside HTTP requests.

  ```yaml
  verify:
    method: codebase
    pattern: "add_options_page|add_menu_page|add_submenu_page|register_setting|wp_remote_(get|post|request)"
    path: "includes"
    expect: absent
  ```

title: Rewrite README for people searching the error, and point them to SEO Pro Stack
body:
<!-- aidevops:brief-schema=v2 -->

## Origin

- **Created:** 2026-10-03
- **Created by:** marcusquinn (ai-interactive)
- **Blocked by:** SEO Pro Stack going public (planned for this weekend). Its `Plugin URI` header points to its GitHub repository, which must load without signing in before this README links to it.
- **Conversation context:** The owner is keeping this plugin because GitHub ranks well for WordPress error searches. Its README should help people who search for the error and point them to SEO Pro Stack, which does this and more.

## What

Rewrite `README.md` (and the description in `readme.txt`) so that it:

1. Opens with the exact error text people search for: `The plugin folder-name/file-name.php has been deactivated due to an error: Plugin file does not exist.` Follow it with a plain explanation of why it happens (a plugin folder deleted by FTP, a host file manager or a migration, while WordPress still lists it in `active_plugins`, `recently_activated` or `uninstall_plugins`).
2. Gives the fix in three ways: with this plugin, by hand (open Plugins, which makes WordPress deactivate it, then WP-CLI `wp option get active_plugins` and `wp plugin list`), and with SEO Pro Stack.
3. Has a short "Want more?" section. It says SEO Pro Stack includes this as "Clean up deleted plugins" (Plugins tab), lists a few of its other features in one line each, and links to it using the `Plugin URI` from SEO Pro Stack's plugin header. Never guess a URL.
4. Covers related searches people make in its headings: "Plugin file does not exist", "deactivated due to an error", "remove missing plugin from WordPress", "plugin still showing after deleting folder".
5. Keeps the GitHub repository description and topics in line (set them with `gh repo edit --description ... --add-topic wordpress,wordpress-plugin,...`).

Present it as what it is: a small, lightweight plugin that fixes this one problem. Fixing the problem comes first; SEO Pro Stack gets a short mention, not a sales page. Use short, plain words in sentence case, and only standard Markdown. Do not overclaim: say what the plugin does and nothing more.

## Why

Search traffic is the reason to keep this plugin. People who arrive should fix their problem first, then find SEO Pro Stack.

## Tier

**Selected tier:** `tier:standard`

**Tier rationale:** Copywriting and search choices within a decided structure.

## How (Approach)

### Files to Modify

- `EDIT: README.md` — rewrite as above
- `EDIT: readme.txt` — short description and FAQ in the same words; under 10 KB
- `EDIT: .wordpress-org/README.md` — remove it if it only repeats README.md

### Verification Before Dispatch

wc -c readme.txt  # under 10240

### Files Scope

- `readme.txt`
- `.wordpress-org/README.md`

### Scope Boundaries

**Hard boundaries:** No code changes; those are in the code clean-up issue. Do not link to SEO Pro Stack until its repository loads without a token. Leave this issue blocked until then.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The first heading or paragraph of README.md contains the exact error text.
